subject: Biology SL
question: Two populations of the same species become separated by a newly formed mountain range. After many generations they no longer produce fertile offspring when brought together. Which conclusion is best supported?

options.text: Speciation has occurred because reproductive isolation has developed.
The two populations must still be one species because they share a common ancestor.
Geographical isolation prevents any genetic change from occurring.
Natural selection must have stopped in both populations.

explanation: Geographical isolation can reduce gene flow. If the populations later become reproductively isolated and cannot produce fertile offspring, this supports the conclusion that speciation has occurred.
explanationJa: 地理的隔離によって遺伝子流動が減少し、その後、両集団が交配しても繁殖可能な子孫を残せなくなったなら、生殖隔離が成立して種分化が起こったと判断できます。

subject: Biology SL
question: If extinction risk and loss of unique genetic variation are the main criteria, which species should receive the highest conservation priority?

options.text: Species P
Species Q
Species R
Species S

explanation: Species P has the smallest population, the narrowest geographic range and low genetic diversity. These factors together indicate high vulnerability to extinction and low capacity to buffer environmental change.
explanationJa: Pは個体数が最も少なく、分布域も1島に限られ、遺伝的多様性も低いため、絶滅リスクが高く環境変化への対応力も低いと考えられます。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Plant abundance along a soil-moisture gradient

question: Which statement is best supported by the data?

options.text: The plant has its highest abundance at an intermediate soil moisture.
The plant cannot survive below 20% soil moisture.
Increasing soil moisture always increases abundance.
Soil moisture is proven to be the only factor controlling distribution.

explanation: Abundance is greatest at 20% soil moisture and lower at both drier and wetter conditions. The data show an association but do not prove that moisture is the only controlling factor.
explanationJa: 個体数は土壌水分20%で最大で、乾燥側・湿潤側の両方で少なくなっています。ただし、このデータだけで水分が唯一の原因だとは証明できません。

subject: Biology SL
question: Two bird species use the same forest. Species X feeds mainly on insects in the canopy, while species Y feeds mainly on seeds on the ground. Which statement best describes their ecological niches?

options.text: Their niches differ because they use different resources and feeding locations.
Their niches are identical because they live in the same habitat.
Neither species has a niche because both are consumers.
A niche is determined only by temperature tolerance.

explanation: A niche includes the resources used, environmental conditions and interactions of a species. Sharing a habitat does not mean two species occupy the same niche.
explanationJa: ニッチには利用する資源、生息条件、他生物との関係などが含まれます。同じ森林に住んでいても、餌や利用場所が異なればニッチは異なります。

subject: Biology SL
question: A person touches a hot surface and withdraws the hand before consciously perceiving pain. Which pathway best explains the rapid response?

options.text: Receptor → sensory neuron → central nervous system → motor neuron → effector
Effector → motor neuron → receptor → sensory neuron
Hormone → receptor → sensory neuron → gland
Receptor → red blood cell → motor neuron → effector

explanation: A withdrawal reflex follows a reflex arc: a receptor detects the stimulus, a sensory neuron carries the signal to the CNS, and a motor neuron carries the response to an effector.
explanationJa: 反射では、受容器が刺激を検出し、感覚ニューロンが中枢神経系へ伝え、運動ニューロンが効果器へ信号を送ります。

question: Why is energy flow through an ecosystem described as one-way while mineral nutrients can be recycled?

options.text: Energy is ultimately lost from trophic transfers as heat, whereas atoms in nutrients can be reused.
Energy atoms are destroyed during respiration.
Mineral nutrients never leave organisms.
Photosynthesis recycles all heat back into sunlight.

explanation: Energy enters ecosystems and is progressively dissipated as heat during biological processes. Matter is conserved, so nutrient atoms can move repeatedly between organisms and the abiotic environment.
explanationJa: エネルギーは生物活動の過程で熱として散逸していくため一方向に流れます。一方、物質を構成する原子は再利用できるため、栄養塩は循環できます。

subject: Biology SL
question: An organism shows a dominant phenotype but its genotype is unknown. It is crossed with a homozygous recessive individual, and half the offspring show the recessive phenotype. What is the genotype of the unknown parent?

options.text: Homozygous dominant
Heterozygous
Homozygous recessive
The genotype cannot be inferred

explanation: A heterozygous parent crossed with a homozygous recessive parent is expected to produce approximately equal numbers of dominant-phenotype and recessive-phenotype offspring.
explanationJa: ヘテロ接合体とホモ接合劣性個体を交配すると、優性表現型と劣性表現型が約1:1で生じるため、未知の親はヘテロ接合体です。

subject: Biology SL
question: A bacterial population contains a rare allele that confers resistance to an antibiotic before the antibiotic is used. After repeated antibiotic treatment, the allele becomes common. Which explanation is most accurate?

options.text: The antibiotic selected for bacteria that already carried the resistance allele.
The antibiotic caused every bacterium to produce the same resistance mutation.
Resistance increased because bacteria stopped reproducing.
Natural selection removed all heritable variation.

explanation: Selection acts on existing heritable variation. Resistant bacteria survive and reproduce more successfully when the antibiotic is present, increasing the frequency of the resistance allele.
explanationJa: 自然選択は既存の遺伝的変異に作用します。抗生物質存在下では耐性個体がより生き残り繁殖するため、耐性対立遺伝子の頻度が上昇します。
